description: Mediation Board Commission - Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators for Special Mediation Boards, which are part of the judicial/legal dispute resolution system. The content involves calling for nominations for judicial officers (mediators) to handle land disputes, issued by the Mediation Boards Commission. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it pertains to the appointment of officers within a statutory judicial body.
